title: Prime Minister expresses grief over loss of lives in fire mishap in Kolkata
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has expressed deep sorrow over the loss of lives due to a fire mishap in Kolkata.
The Prime Minister conveyed his condolences to those who have lost their loved ones in the tragedy and prayed for the speedy recovery of the injured. He said that the local administration is assisting those who are affected.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X;
“Extremely pained to learn about the loss of lives due to a fire mishap in Kolkata. My condolences to those who have lost their loved ones in this tragedy. May the injured recover at the earliest. The local administration is assisting those who are affected: PM @narendramodi”
Extremely pained to learn about the loss of lives due to a fire mishap in Kolkata. My condolences to those who have lost their loved ones in this tragedy. May the injured recover at the earliest. The local administration is assisting those who are affected: PM @narendramodi — PMO India (@PMOIndia) August 19, 2026
কলকাতায় অগ্নিকাণ্ডে প্রাণহানির খবর শুনে অত্যন্ত মর্মাহত । এই দুর্ঘটনায় যাঁরা তাঁদের প্রিয়জনকে হারিয়েছেন, তাঁদের প্রতি আমার সমবেদনা রইল। আহতরা যেন দ্রুত আরোগ্য লাভ করেন। স্থানীয় প্রশাসন দুর্গতদের সহায়তা করছে: প্রধানমন্ত্রী @narendramodi — PMO India (@PMOIndia) August 19, 2026

enrichment.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed grief over loss of lives in a fire mishap in Kolkata, conveying condolences to bereaved families and wishing speedy recovery to the injured. He noted that the local administration is assisting those affected. The statement was posted on X by the PMO in both English and Bengali.
enrichment.context: This is a routine condolence message issued by the Prime Minister's Office following a fire tragedy in Kolkata. Such statements are standard practice after disasters or accidents in India, serving to convey national leadership's acknowledgment of the tragedy without announcing any new policy, compensation scheme, or investigative action. No details about the cause of the fire, casualty figures, or specific relief measures are provided in this release.
